scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @rttw/domain && npm run dev --workspace @rttw/web
scripts.api: npm run build --workspace @rttw/domain && npm run dev --workspace @rttw/api
scripts.api:local: npm run build --workspace @rttw/domain && npm run dev:local --workspace @rttw/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @rttw/domain && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run check:instructions && npm run typecheck
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @rttw/domain && npm run build --workspace @rttw/web && npm run build --workspace @rttw/api
